provenance.note: Fictional company written for harness validation. Not a real company; any resemblance is coincidental.

evidence.text: Medivault Imaging AI develops software that flags suspected lung nodules on CT scans. Medivault runs entirely inside the hospital network on an on-premises server; no patient image is sent to the internet.

Medivault Triage is CE-marked as medical device software. We deliver Medivault Triage preinstalled on a dedicated inference server that we procure from third-party manufacturers and install in the radiology department.
Medivault Imaging AI announced that Medivault Triage is now deployed in 31 hospitals and that the company is seeking a long-term hardware partner to standardize its inference servers.
